notes: adolescentBirthRate 3: UN WPP/National Statistics Taiwan - ~3 births per 1,000 women 15-19 (georank.org citing UN WPP 2023); Taiwan has among the world's lowest teen fertility.
laborForceGap -15: DGBAS 2024 labour force participation ~52% women vs ~67% men aged 15+.
childMarriagePercent 1: estimate - minimum marriage age raised to 18 (both sexes) in 2023; under-18 marriage now vanishingly rare; no UNICEF MICS exists for Taiwan.
contraceptiveUse 75: estimate from Taiwanese KAP (Knowledge-Attitude-Practice) survey tradition (~75-80% historically); Taiwan not covered by UN World Contraceptive Use tables.
childMarriagePercent 14.7: CIA World Factbook field 'Women married by age 18' = 14.7% (2018) for Tokelau.
contraceptiveUse 59.6: CIA World Factbook contraceptive prevalence, married women 15-49, 59.6% (2021 est.).

adolescentBirthRate 20: estimate - no published series; Tokelau (~1,500 people, CBR ~25/1000, SPC statistics) follows the elevated Polynesian atoll pattern, above NZ's 10.3 (NZ Pacific-peoples ABR ~16).
laborForceGap -10: derived from NZ anchor (-8.7) widened slightly for a subsistence/public-sector atoll economy where paid work skews male.
US Minor Outlying Islands have NO permanent population (transient refuge staff/researchers only), so no demographic statistics exist.

All four values are nominal US anchors per the brief's US-territory rule: ABR 12.4 and laborForceGap -10.7 are the verified US values; childMarriagePercent 6 (US ~5-6% of women married before 18) and contraceptiveUse 73.9 (UN WCU US any-method).
Values should be treated as placeholders, not measurements of the territory itself.

Italy-anchored derivation (batch_29 had nulled these; this repair pass fills with defensible estimates per brief). Vatican City's ~500-800 residents are celibate clergy/religious, so true rates are effectively 0/undefined.
adolescentBirthRate 2 and contraceptiveUse 65: Italy values (IT ABR 2.9; UN WCU any-method 65.1) rounded down; childMarriagePercent 0 (Italian law min age 18, effectively zero).
laborForceGap -17.5: Italy's verified gap; the Vatican workforce is overwhelmingly male clergy/Swiss Guard, so the true gap is more male-skewed, but -17.5 is the defensible anchor.
No statistical office exists for the Holy See; these are nominal Italy-anchored estimates.
contraceptiveUse 57.2: CIA World Factbook contraceptive prevalence, married women 15-49, 57.2% (2018 est.) for Wallis & Futuna.

adolescentBirthRate 25: estimate - INSEE/IEOM show elevated teen fertility across the French Pacific (New Caledonia ~22, French Polynesia ~35 per 1,000 women 15-19) vs metropolitan France's 3.3; Wallis & Futuna sits between them.
childMarriagePercent 1: French civil law sets minimum marriage age at 18; under-18 marriage is near-zero in the territory.
laborForceGap -10: derived from FR anchor (-8.1) widened slightly - the WF economy is subsistence agriculture plus public administration, with paid employment skewing male.
No international series covers Western Sahara separately (not a WB member; no DHS/MICS); all four values are Morocco-anchored derivations per brief.
adolescentBirthRate 28: Morocco verified 24.8, scaled up for EH's younger age structure and higher total fertility (CIA est. TFR ~4.3 vs Morocco ~2.1).
childMarriagePercent 16: anchored on Morocco's verified 16%; no EH-specific survey exists.
laborForceGap -45: Morocco verified -48.4, moderated slightly by settler/public-sector employment of women in Laayoune.
contraceptiveUse 62: Morocco verified 70.8, scaled down for weaker health-service coverage outside main towns.
childMarriagePercent 7.4: CIA World Factbook 'Women married by age 18' = 7.4% (2020) for American Samoa.
contraceptiveUse 62: CIA World Factbook contraceptive prevalence, married women 15-49, 62% (2020 est.).
laborForceGap -10: derived from US anchor (-10.7); 2020 Census Island Areas data show female participation slightly below male in the cannery/public-sector economy.
adolescentBirthRate 34.7 already present and confirmed against WB SP.ADO.TFRT (2024: 34.7) - left unchanged.
laborForceGap -7: World Bank Country Gender Scorecard for Antigua & Barbuda - 2018 Labour Force Survey participation 69% women vs 76% men.
contraceptiveUse 53: WB SP.DYN.CONU.ZS / UN World Contraceptive Use, any method, 53% (1998 survey - latest available for Antigua & Barbuda).
childMarriagePercent 4: estimate - no national survey; legal minimum marriage age 18; small-island Caribbean prevalence is low (regional LAC average well under 10%).
adolescentBirthRate 32.1 already present and confirmed against WB API (2024: 32.1) - left unchanged.
contraceptiveUse 46.8: CIA World Factbook contraceptive prevalence, married women 15-49, 46.8% (2020 est.) for Aruba.

laborForceGap -12: CBS Aruba/DAO Labour Force Survey 2023 shows women's unemployment above men's (3.9% vs 4.0%) and lower participation; NL anchor (-9.2) widened for the tourism/part-time employment structure that pulls women out of the measured labour force.
childMarriagePercent 1: Dutch civil law minimum marriage age 18; under-18 marriage effectively nonexistent.
adolescentBirthRate 18 already present and confirmed against WB API (2024: 18.0) - left unchanged.
contraceptiveUse 49.7: CIA World Factbook contraceptive prevalence, married women 15-49, 49.7% (2016 est.) for Bermuda.

laborForceGap -5: Bermuda Census 2000 labour-force chapter - female LFPR reached 80% vs ~85% male (16-64); recent gov.bm LFS shows overall participation 83.5%, among the world's highest, with a persistently small gap.
childMarriagePercent 1: estimate - marriage age 18 under Bermuda law; under-18 marriage rare.
adolescentBirthRate 1.5 already present and confirmed against WB API (2024: 1.5) - left unchanged.
